builds.goal: Reference for Kha'Zix: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: An isolation hunter who selects separated targets and uses invisibility to refresh an empowered opening attack. Record isolation and evolution choices. An attack-led route must earn sustained contact; do not grant isolated Q damage against clustered enemies. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
builds.summary: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Kha'Zix: Record isolation and evolution choices. An attack-led route must earn sustained contact; do not grant isolated Q damage against clustered enemies.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on Isolated targets. If he chooses to Evolve Reaper Claws, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against Isolated targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

builds.name: Unseen Return Strike
builds.summary: Count P packets after each verified unseen interval.
builds.goal: Count P packets after each verified unseen interval.
builds.hypothesis: P refreshes when unseen and adds AD-scaled magic damage plus slow to the next champion attack. R primary description grants invisibility and explicitly triggers P; Trinity/Sundered Sky support one real return attack, Stridebreaker assists leaving vision and re-entering. No resolved R duration is assumed.
testPlan: Required state: Record actual R evolution/casts and whether enemy vision truly loses Khazix.
Count P packets after each verified unseen interval; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Detection or kiting denies P refresh and access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Every R cast is not automatically a fresh attack or a ready Spellblade proc.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Sundered Sky, Stridebreaker, Eclipse, Death's Dance, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
